title: RentaGuard
description: A paid message from RentaGuard. Personal protection on a budget.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-nasal
lines.text: [question-en] Feeling unsafe? <p:0.2> RentaGuard sends a discount bodyguard to your door in minutes! <p:0.2> He's large, he's loyal-ish, he's mostly sober. <p:0.2> RentaGuard, he'll probably take the hit!

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Guard may switch sides for a sandwich. <p:0> Provides protection, not allegiance. <p:0> He lives with you now. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
